title: Phil R NDE 9816
content: It was a standard day at work in the production office. I was preparing for our mid-morning production meeting at my desk. I was noting down questions to be asked of my superiors in the meeting. This is the last thing I remember consciously. My colleagues have told me, I took a large intake of breath and slumped in my chair. The chair spun and I ended up on the office floor, having an intense seizure. I punched myself, bruising my nose and face. An ambulance was called and family was informed. After medical attention at hospital and further tests, it was determined that I have a congenital heart condition called hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and I was fitted with a internal loop recorder. This ended up being a god-send as I had an exact replica cardiac arrest 5 weeks later while at home. It was captured by my loop recorder, giving the medical staff a better insight into what was happening to me. On both occasions, I was completely unconscious and seized for around 2 minutes. While my heart was stopped, I was very aware of my near death experiences. In both cases, there was a fleeting review of my life via thousands of photo snapshots being shown to me in a warming, nurturing, and healing light. Having taken quite a few party drugs in my youth it was most akin to MDMA's warmth, but it was far more intense, loving, nurturing and there was a complete sense of well-being and calm. It felt as if ultimate knowledge and love (the universe/god) was appraising my life experience and downloading it back to me in rapid fire. I would say without question, it was the most at peace and harmony with the universe I have ever felt in my nearly 40 years on this planet. I haven't had any issues like this in almost 3 years now. My ongoing heart problems are still being investigated. It's probably worth noting this was caused by genetics and not brought on by C-19 vaccinations (which I refused) or lifestyle. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 13/04/2021 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Heart attack Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? No. I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I was fully conscious of what was happening in my head but knew nothing of the living world at all At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Whilst my heart was stopped Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. Things happened at an unexplainably fast rate but could also be absorbed. Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. My vision was completely focused on the life review of photo snapshots Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Hearing wasn't altered and I don't remember any words Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Uncertain Maybe not a tunnel but a warm light source Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Warm light source Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. Warm, nurturing, pleasant, all-knowing realm of love What emotions did you feel during the experience? I was no longer in contact with the living world Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? My past flashed before me; out of my control. My life was reviewed in snapshot images in a backdrop of light Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Unaffiliated- Agnostic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes More connected to a higher being and the universe. What is your religion now? Unaffiliated- Agnostic Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I thought prior to the experience that most likely there is a realm we exist in after our physical bodies die. Now, I am sure of it. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I now pray. It is more of an internal appreciation to the universe Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Uncertain. Opened my minde to possible previous lives/afterlife. During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Uncertain Something other worldly/all knowing about the whole experience. During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Uncertain It was profound enough for me to believe there is potentially an afterlife and a creator. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Uncertain. I do now, after the NDE. A feeling that I now know whatever happens to our mind and body after life is insignificant and that our souls live on. During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? No Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Uncertain. Love and a motherly nurturing tranquility was the main feelings I felt when in my life review/ near death experience. What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life. I have definitely grown more spiritual after the experiences, more connected to my health and family. I now think of this life as a brief physical realm we visit from time to time and maybe even purgatory, before we return to the love and all-knowing realm I briefly visited. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes It was so overwhelming it was hard to put it into words straight away other than - death is going to be the best moment of your life. It was so profound I wasn't sure how to communicate it initially, but hours later in hospital I shared it with the nurses and doctors who didn't seem to care or think it was important. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. It was so profound, it sticks out. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Just the knowledge that the nonphysical realm exists. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Shared it directly afterwards both times in hospital with nurses, doctors, family and colleagues. I found it more interesting than the medical prognosis; they did not! Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. 100 percent certain; the experience was a beautiful one. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. 100 percent certain; the experience was a beautiful one. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? This has been quite in-depth and considered. h5z3x3h_nde

I was noting down questions to be asked of my superiors in the meeting. This is the last thing I remember consciously. My colleagues have told me, I took a large intake of breath and slumped in my chair. The chair spun and I ended up on the office floor, having an intense seizure. I punched myself, bruising my nose and face. An ambulance was called and family was informed. After medical attention at hospital and further tests, it was determined that I have a congenital heart condition called hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and I was fitted with a internal loop recorder. This ended up being a god-send as I had an exact replica cardiac arrest 5 weeks later while at home. It was captured by my loop recorder, giving the medical staff a better insight into what was happening to me. On both occasions, I was completely unconscious and seized for around 2 minutes. While my heart was stopped, I was very aware of my near death experiences. In both cases, there was a fleeting review of my life via thousands of photo snapshots being shown to me in a warming, nurturing, and healing light. Having taken quite a few party drugs in my youth it was most akin to MDMA's warmth, but it was far more intense, loving, nurturing and there was a complete sense of well-being and calm. It felt as if ultimate knowledge and love (the universe/god) was appraising my life experience and downloading it back to me in rapid fire. I would say without question, it was the most at peace and harmony with the universe I have ever felt in my nearly 40 years on this planet. I haven't had any issues like this in almost 3 years now. My ongoing heart problems are still being investigated. It's probably worth noting this was caused by genetics and not brought on by C-19 vaccinations (which I refused) or lifestyle.
